name: Apar Industries Ltd
tagline: NSE/BSE: APARINDS | EXCLUDED from 10x ranking - already large-cap
business_overview: Apar Industries (founded 1958) is a market leader in power transmission conductors (23% market share, ~45% of revenue), transformer/specialty oils, and cables, with a global presence.
source_notes: Source sheet noted 'solid engagement on the results post; clear positive emphasis on EPS growth' - a legitimate quality business, just not sized for this specific screen.
fundamentals_table: Rs 66,830 Cr (large-cap, +91% in the past year)
fundamentals_narrative: This is a well-run, large, and clearly high-quality industrial business with an active long-running ValuePickr thread ('Apar Industries - Above Par and Transformative for Investors?', discussed since 2016). It has already delivered an enormous re-rating (+91% in the last year alone, on top of a multi-year run). None of that changes the arithmetic: at ~Rs 66,830 Cr, a 10x would require the company to reach roughly Rs 6.7 lakh Cr (~$80bn) within 2-3 years - a scale jump with no real-world precedent for an industrial conductors/cables business in that timeframe.
technical_read: Not researched in depth - excluded on market-cap grounds before the technical step, consistent with the project's scoring framework (market-cap headroom is a hard gate, not just one factor among many).
sentiment_summary: Active, long-tenured ValuePickr community coverage since 2016 with generally constructive sentiment on the conductor/specialty-oil business mix and value-unlocking discussions. This reflects a genuinely well-regarded compounder, just not a candidate for this specific 10x-in-2-3-years screen.
bse_notes: No red flags surfaced; not pursued further given the size-based exclusion.
